items.title: Edgar Joseph Interview, 1961-08-07
items.q: I use Charlie Hamilton. Yeah, piano player. Play piano with me.

ctx.x: them bands, man, you could let them, look at them in the stores there. Man, you worried about them, man, they come up here to make money. We

make them. We made it on that. Time around from that, they hired me. I played the world convention, I wish I had that picture to show you. I had a book of me. The whole village, I tell you who was playing with me. Boy was like Dr. Cleo, you remember Cleo, you played bass? Oh yeah. You played with Howard. I had Cleo, you remember Tato. Oh yeah. Point out playing with me. Alto. Alto, yeah. I had his brother on piano and had a boy that called Paul Antwine and Harmon Antwine. We played at the world convention. Tony…
run them in the river with it. That's right. What do you think makes the difference between the young man and the old man?

items.title: Edgar "Sambo" Joseph Interview, 1960-08-07
items.q: I got a good set up of boys... I use Bigfoot Billy. I use Charlie Anthony. Charlie Hamilton?

ctx.x: You got fellas that's playing. You know they see another band, they get scared. Well, I'm not scared of nobody. If a man's better than me, he's this better than me. That's what I was thinking. Sure. You understand what I mean? I'll take it like that. If you better than me, I ain't gonna say nothing. Well, someday I might catch up with you. You understand what I mean? I might catch up with you. I don't say I'm no star. You understand what I mean? Well, I'm gonna do my part when I'm supposed to do. And right now…
